output.title: Everyone Else Is Reading This Too
output.excerpt: An essay written on the assumption that it will be read by everyone. The premise I was given is strange, so let me take it seriously. Suppose this essay really were read by everyone. Not by the people who already agree with it, not by the people with time to read essays, but by everyone: the woman…

summary: Everyone Else Is Reading This Too is an essay arguing that a piece everyone reads could do the most good by correcting what people believe about one another. It draws on research on pluralistic ignorance to show that most people are more honest, moderate and cooperative than they assume, and it explains what that misperception costs and which small actions could change it.
